title: Postcomposition naturality of the explicit Koszul class
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbb N$, and $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$. Let $L,F$ be arbitrary integer cochain complexes of $O_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}$-modules, $e\in\mathbb N$, $s:\widetilde I_e\to L$ and $t:L\to F$. Assume the derived categories of sheaf modules on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and of $A$-modules as in the Lean statement [def-pc-derived-category]. Define $z_e(L,s)$ to be koszulOpenHomStageClass [lem-sc-koszul-open-hom-chain-representatives], followed by $H^0(Q(\iota_e))$ and by $H^0(\operatorname{koszulCechDerivedComparison}(L))$ [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. Write $G$ for the right derived functor of affineOpenSections at $U=\bigcup_jD(f_j)$ [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Then $H^0(G(Q(t)))(z_e(L,s))=z_e(F,s\,t)$. No quasi-coherence hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Construct the module Hom-complex postcomposition chain map from Cochain.comp and δ_comp_ofHom. Its map on cycles is determined by cyclesMap_i and moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_iCycles; homologyπ_naturality therefore sends the class of a chain map s to the class of its composite. Use ordinary tilde/sections adjunction homEquiv_naturality_right, naturality of homologyFunctorFactors.inv, and cancellation of the stage object isomorphism to obtain stage-class postcomposition naturality. This uses only the actual stage-class definitions, not the quasi-coherent chain-representative equivalence theorem.

Apply colimit.ι_desc to express the stage-to-Cech comparison by the specified cocone. Transport to principalCechTotal and use principalCechFunctor_exists to identify the coefficient map componentwise. On each nonempty ordered subset J, cancel product(f_j)^(e+1) using Scheme.Modules.isSMulRegular_of_le_basicOpen. The two specified cocone denominator equations then reduce equality to restriction naturality; postcomposition evaluates as coefficient-map composition, and the integer sign commutes with the additive coefficient map. This proves equality of stage-to-Cech chain maps for every degree, without quasi-coherence.

Construct the natural resolution roof using the functorial K-injective resolution I and its quasi-isomorphism η, the Cech augmentation a on I, and the right-derived-functor unit b. The augmentation on I is invertible by principalCechAugmentation_quasiIso and the image of η is invertible. Thus β=C(η) followed by inverse(a_I), b_I, and inverse(G(Qη)) is a natural transformation. For each complex, cancel the invertible resolution, derived-object identification, and augmentation in the characterization principalCechDerivedComparison_exists to prove that its chosen comparison equals β.app. Naturality follows from β.naturality.

Apply Q to the stage-to-Cech equality and compose with the Cech derived comparison. Use its naturality, cancel Q of the inverse stage-object isomorphism, and apply H^0. Preservation of composition by Q and H^0 and stage-class naturality give the displayed element equality. The calculations are uniform for the empty cover, zero ring, zero maps, and zero complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulOpenHom_chain_class_naturality
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (L F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (e : ℕ) (s : koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e ⟶ L) (t : L ⟶ F) :
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    let G := (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor
    H.map (G.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map t))
      (H.map (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f L)
        (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι
          (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
            (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L)) e))
          (koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f L e s))) =
    H.map (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f F)
      (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι
        (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
          (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F)) e))
        (koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f F e (s ≫ t)))
